question: Should OpenClaw restore `PluginRuntime.channel.turn` as a deprecated compatibility contract, and should that contract be limited to the inbound-shaped helper subset in this PR?
rationale: This is a public plugin-runtime compatibility decision: source and user reports show real shipped plugin breakage, but restoring a retired API name and deciding helper-name scope requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept Scoped Alias
options.body: Refresh the branch and land the current object-identical alias while keeping `channel.inbound.*` canonical and documenting the scoped deprecated surface.

options.title: Broaden Legacy Helper Coverage
options.body: Require the PR to also restore the old helper names from the removed `turn` object before merge if maintainers want full legacy API coverage.

options.title: Reject Core Alias
options.body: Close or pause the PR if maintainers decide old channel plugins must ship updates instead of re-expanding the core PluginRuntime surface.

recommendation.title: Accept Scoped Alias
recommendation.body: Refresh the branch and land the current object-identical alias while keeping `channel.inbound.*` canonical and documenting the scoped deprecated surface.

likelyOwner.reason: The compatibility decision is closest to the commit that removed the aliases and the plugin-runtime API boundary now under review.
